reasoning: The icon clearly depicts an ECG/pulse waveform inside a rectangular screen frame, universally understood as a heart rate monitor, medical vital signs display, or system health/activity monitor. It fits tasks involving cardiology tests (ECG/Holter), fitness heart-rate tracking, electronics oscilloscopes, and IT server monitoring. It is distinct from financial line charts because the line enters and exits horizontally at the midline with a single classic heartbeat deflection.

readings.meaning: ECG / heart rate monitor / medical monitor

pass1.ambiguity: Could be confused with a generic line chart, stock ticker, or audio waveform at very small sizes, though the single dip-and-spike is characteristic of a heartbeat/pulse.
